title: ArticlesHandoff
description: Output of the Scraper Agent containing parsed articles from verified news sources.

published_at.description: ISO 8601 or RFC 2822 published timestamp (null if missing from source)

text_summary.description: Extracted article body or summary text

full_text.description: Cleaned extracted full text, capped at 6000 chars. INTERNAL ONLY for Editor Agent, never published.

word_count.description: Word count of the extracted full text

scraped_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when article was scraped

age_hours.description: Age of the article in hours relative to scrape reference time

category_hint.description: Rough canonical topic category inferred from feed tags, URL path, or keywords

raw_tags.description: Original feed category/tag labels from the publisher RSS item

importance_hint.description: Normalized editorial importance hint (0.0-1.0) derived from feed position and priority tags

feed_position.description: 1-based position in the source feed or homepage link list

priority_score.description: Normalized priority score combining recency, position, tags, and trust

method.description: Winning extraction method: trafilatura, json_ld, meta_description, or rss_summary

degraded_run.description: Set on every article of a degraded pass
